question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

Hatred can be overcome by love.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Love can overcome hatred.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is an example of Passive Voice. As per the given question we have to change it into Active Voice. 
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'Hatred'. 
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'Love'. 
 
• Since modal verb has been used in the passive voice, therefore, the active voice will follow the given structure:-
 
 
• Active Voice - modal verb*(can) *+ V1 
 
• Passive Voice - modal verb*(can)* + be + V3 
 
 
 
• Here, 'can be overcome' is changed into 'can overcome' because in 'passive to active' transformation first form of the verb is used. 

 ​
 
 

Correct Sentence:__ *Love can overcome hatred.*
